subject: Re: CoDi status: SR repro solid, 1-step quality is the open risk
body:
All,

Decisions for the May 22 launch review:

1. Headline claim is 4-step parity with 50-step sampling on FID/LPIPS, full stop. The 1-step mode ships behind the experimental toggle exactly as Csilla proposed. I've already reset expectations with the field team.

2. Scope cut: InstructPix2Pix drops from the launch. It's 80% there but the eval set isn't stable, and I won't put a wobbling number on the leaderboard we built specifically to be trustworthy. It lands as a fast-follow in June.

3. Zeke - demo endpoint is on Shipyard, Oyin will send the serving config Thursday; we need LRB sign-off before anything is shown externally, and Nadia has us on the May 22 board agenda.

Good quarter, team. The 10x serving-cost story is intact.

Zofia
